trigger_condition: Catalog entry whose id/base_name/deployment_name are empty or whitespace-only strings
guard_snippet: const id = extractModelId(model)?.trim(); if (!id || model.enabled === false || seen.has(id)) continue;
potential_consequence: A model with id '' and name '' is written to chatLanguageModels.json

trigger_condition: Tenant catalog holds non-chat deployments such as embeddings, image, TTS or whisper models
guard_snippet: if (!known && isNonChatDeployment(descriptor)) continue; // e.g. by descriptor type/id pattern
potential_consequence: Non-chat models are listed as chat models with toolCalling true; selecting one fails every request

trigger_condition: Known capability family, but catalog reports features.tools false or multimodal false
guard_snippet: const entry = known ? { ...known, toolCalling: descriptor.toolCalling ?? known.toolCalling, vision: known.vision && descriptor.multimodal !== false } : buildDefaultVsCodeCapability(descriptor);
potential_consequence: Table values override tenant flags; VS Code sends tools/images the deployment rejects

trigger_condition: Unknown GPT id at 5.5 or later, such as gpt-5.7 or gpt-5.6-nova
guard_snippet: return major > 5 || (major === 5 && minor >= 5); // parse minor as well as major
potential_consequence: A responses-only model gets chat-completions and no zero data retention, so requests fail

trigger_condition: GPT-6+ id with a vendor prefix other than openai., e.g. azure.gpt-6-sol
potential_consequence: GPT-6 model is set to chat-completions, which its Responses-only API rejects

trigger_condition: resolveTenantModelId + pickMostRecent collapsed dated, vertex and prefixed variants to one deployment per family
guard_snippet: Group descriptors by findVsCodeCapabilityEntry(id) family; for known families keep only resolveTenantModelId(family, ids)
potential_consequence: Every variant, e.g. claude-opus-4-5, -vertex and -20251101, appears as a duplicate picker entry
